notes.title: Patch V1.0.2
notes.notes: Added coloured markers around player that point towards off screen enemies

notes.title: Update V1.0.1
notes.notes:
Added some new features, QOL for artifacts, bug fixes and new boss

Introduced the artifact evolution system! Dissolve artifacts in the items menu to get 1 token for each dissolved artifact. Use 10 tokens to evolve 1 artifact! Currently all artifacts only have a tier 2 upgrade (may add tier 3 in the future)

Players can now reorganise their artifact sequence in the items menu! Hold middle mouse button over an artifact in the items menu to drag and rearrange it.

Bug fixes:
Fixed accidentally opening the relic door and crate at the same time
Fixed cuts being unable to activate occasionally

Added new boss: Gaelbolg the Hollow
Gaelbolg will now appear at level 75, armed with 20 spears. He moves fast and attacks fast. Be careful
